text.p: Valores Finamex said in a report released Friday that it had downgraded Alfa, S.A. de C.V. to market performer from buy.

- Alfa shares have outperformed the Bolsa in dollars by 14 percentage points, appreciating 27 percent year-to-date, reflecting confidence in management, a positive outlook regarding expansion plans, and impressive 1996 results, Valores Finamex analyst Angeli Hemm said.
-- "However, we believe all the good news is currently reflected in the share price and expect the shares to perform in line with the market going forward," Hemm said.

- An unfavorable outlook for international steel and petrochemical markets, a resilient peso and continued double digit inflation is expected to produce notable declines in Alfa's operating results, Valores Finamex said.
- "Poor year-over-year comparisons anticipated over the first three quarters of 1997 should dampen interest in the shares," worte Hemm.
